description: Translates comments, selections, and documents with a language model or a translation service.
setting.server.path: The absolute path of the `translation-lsp` executable, including `.exe` on Windows. The extension does not start without it.
setting.targetLanguage: The language to translate into: an ISO 639 language code such as `ja` or `pt-BR`, or a name such as `Japanese`.
setting.sourceLanguage: The language of the text, or `auto` to let the translation identify it.
setting.provider.name: The translation provider. Each provider page of the documentation lists what it needs, such as an account or an API key. Without one, the server translates nothing.
setting.provider.baseUrl: The address of the service, such as `http://localhost:11434/v1`. Used by OpenAI-compatible API, and PLaMo Translate.
setting.provider.model: The model that translates. Leave empty for the provider's default, where it has one. Used by ChatGPT, Anthropic API, OpenAI API, OpenAI-compatible API, and PLaMo Translate.
setting.provider.effort: The reasoning effort. With ChatGPT and OpenAI API: `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max`. With Anthropic API: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max`. With an OpenAI-compatible API, the service's own value. Leave empty to leave it out. Used by ChatGPT, Anthropic API, OpenAI API, and OpenAI-compatible API.
setting.provider.thinking: Whether the model thinks before it answers. `auto` leaves it to the server, which turns it off only for the default model up to `high` effort. Used by Anthropic API.
setting.provider.speed: The speed. With ChatGPT and OpenAI API: `auto`, `default`, `flex`, `scale`, `priority`, `fast`, or `ultrafast`. With Anthropic API: `standard` or `fast`. Leave empty to leave it out. Used by ChatGPT, Anthropic API, and OpenAI API.
setting.provider.document.model: Another model for translations opened in a tab. Leave empty to translate tabs with the settings above; the document settings below are sent only with this model. Used by ChatGPT, Anthropic API, OpenAI API, and OpenAI-compatible API.
setting.provider.document.effort: The reasoning effort for tab translations, with the values of `Provider: Effort`. Leave empty to leave it out. Used by ChatGPT, Anthropic API, OpenAI API, and OpenAI-compatible API.
setting.provider.document.thinking: Whether the model thinks before it answers in tab translations, as `Provider: Thinking`. Used by Anthropic API.
setting.provider.document.speed: The speed of tab translations, with the values of `Provider: Speed`. Leave empty to leave it out. Used by ChatGPT, Anthropic API, and OpenAI API.
setting.features.commentHover: Hover over a comment starts its translation.
setting.features.automaticSelection: A stable selection in Markdown starts its translation.
setting.features.selectionAction: Offers the `Translate selection to …` Code Action.
setting.features.documentAction: Offers the Code Actions that open a translation in a tab, in Markdown and Plain Text.
setting.features.commentLens: Shows a CodeLens line on comments with no translation.
setting.features.languages: The features of one language, by its language ID, with the names of the server, such as `{"yaml": {"comment_hover": false}}`. JavaScript settings also apply to `.jsx` files.
setting.hover.header: Shows the title `Translation LSP` and the provider's note above a translation.
setting.hoverTimeoutMs: The deadline of each Hover, in milliseconds, from its receipt and including queue time.
setting.selectionTimeoutMs: The time a selection translation may take once it starts, in milliseconds.
setting.documentTimeoutMs: The time a translation opened in a tab may take once it starts, in milliseconds.
setting.selectionDebounceMs: How long the server waits after a new selection, in milliseconds.
setting.commentParseTimeoutMs: The limit on reading the comments of a C, C++, C#, or Python document, in milliseconds.
setting.translationLimits.inputKib.hover: The largest text, in KiB, that comment Hover, automatic selection, and selection translations shown in Hover send.
setting.translationLimits.inputKib.docum: The largest text, in KiB, that a translation opened in a tab sends.
setting.translationLimits.work.admitted: Translations running and queued at once.
setting.translationLimits.work.automatic: Translations kept only by comment Hover or automatic selection. Must be less than `Admitted`.
setting.translationLimits.cache.capacity: The text of the results kept in memory, in KiB.
setting.documentSplit.enabled: Sends a long translation opened in a tab in parts.
setting.documentSplit.parallel: The parts that one tab translation sends at once.
setting.documentSplit.chunkKib: The size that a part aims at, in KiB.
setting.diskCache.enabled: Keeps completed translations on disk, so that they are used again after the server restarts.
setting.diskCache.days: Removes a translation on disk not used for this many days.
setting.hover.format.markdown: With the formatting the translation writes, and other characters as written.
setting.hover.format.text: In a code block, as written.
